name: pixabay-mcp
description: Servidor MCP de Pixabay: remoto (Vercel) y extensión de Claude Desktop (.mcpb)

scripts.build:mcpb: esbuild src/stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=mcpb/server/index.mjs && mcpb validate mcpb/manifest.json && mcpb pack mcpb dist/pixabay.mcpb
